# trae-cn-provider 把 **Trae CN** 作为一个**原生 LLM provider** 接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）。 安装后 Trae 的模型会直接出现在 DSH 的模型选择器里，也可以额外开出一个 OpenAI 兼容接口给 Cline / Claude Code 之类的客户端用。 macOS 优先、源码可审计、**凭据不出本机**。 --- ## ⚠️ 先读这一段：风险声明 1. **本项目违反 Trae（字节跳动）的使用条款。** 它把 Trae 客户端内部的接口当作通用 LLM API 使用，这不是官方支持的用法。 2. **你的 Trae 账号有被封禁的风险。** 请自行判断是否接受。 3. 消耗的是**你自己账号的额度/积分**。本项目不提供、不转让、不代充任何额度。 4. 本项目与 Trae、字节跳动**没有任何关系**，未获其授权或背书。 5. 请**不要**把本插件连同你的凭据一起分发。凭据只应存在于你自己的机器上。 6. 作者不对因使用本项目产生的任何后果负责（包括但不限于账号封禁、额度损失、数据问题）。**如果你不接受以上任何一条，请不要安装。** --- ## 它做什么 - 以 DSH **原生 `LlmAdapter`** 的形式注册一个 provider route：`trae-cn` - 模型自动出现在模型选择器（从 Trae 的模型目录实时拉取） - 支持流式正文、思考链（reasoning）、原生 function calling、上下文窗口、思考档位 - 支持**图片输入**（多模态模型）：DSH 的图片块经 attachments 缝内联为 data URL；OpenAI 层也接受 `image_url` - 可选：在宿主已有的 web server 上挂一个 OpenAI 兼容面（`/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`），**不自己占用端口** - 同时提供一个独立 CLI，可脱离 DSH 单独当本地代理跑 ## 它不做什么 - 不代理、不中转、不上传任何凭据到第三方。**代码里出网的域名只有 Trae 官方域名**（见「出网清单」）。 - 不共享额度给别人，不做多账号池，不做额度转卖。 - 不修改 Trae 客户端，不 hook 它的进程。 --- ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装到 web profile（安装即激活：会自动追加进 dsh.profile.bundles） dsh plugin --profile web add trae-cn-provider # 桌面版：需要先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用 dsh plugin --profile desktop add trae-cn-provider ``` > **桌面 profile 的坑**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 要求桌面应用完全退出后再执行 > （否则报 `Open DeepSeek Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile, then fully quit it`）。 > 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile

remove trae-cn-provider`。 安装后重启对应 profile 即可。模型选择器里会出现 **Trae CN** 分组。 --- ## 登录与凭据来源 插件有三档凭据来源，通过 `credentialSource` 配置： | 值 | 行为 | 需要浏览器 | 包内是否存在解密凭据的代码路径 | |---|---|---|---| | `oauth`（**默认**） | 只在 DSH 里走一次浏览器登录，凭据存本机 | 是（一次） | **否** | | `local` | 直接读本机已登录的 Trae 客户端凭据 | 否 | **是（显式开启才生效）** | | `auto` | 先看已保存的 OAuth 凭据，没有再看本机客户端 | 视情况 | 是（同上） | ### `oauth`（默认，推荐） 在 DSH 里执行登录命令（默认 `/trae-login`），会打开浏览器到 Trae 官方授权页： ``` https://www.trae.cn/authorization?...&auth_callback_url=http://127.0.0.1:/authorize ``` **实测发现：Trae 的回调不是下发授权码，而是直接把凭据塞进回调参数**（`userJwt` 是 URL 编码的 JSON，含 `Token` / `RefreshToken` / `TokenExpireAt`；`userInfo` 含 `UserID` / `Name`）。所以不存在「换码」这一步。回调只在 `127.0.0.1` 上临时监听，拿完即关。 凭据默认落在 `~/.trae-proxy/credentials.json`（权限 `0600`）。若 DSH 的 `credentials` 服务可用，会优先存进那里。 目录可以用环境变量 `TRAE_PROXY_CRED_DIR` 覆盖（测试用它做隔离；也可以在你想把凭据放到别处时用）。 ### `local`（可选，零摩擦） 直接读本机 Trae 客户端的登录态，**不需要浏览器**。支持两种存储格式，运行时自动嗅探： | edition | 存储格式 | 上游 | |---|---|---| | `cn` Trae CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `solo` TRAE SOLO CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `sg` Trae 国际版 | 明文 JSON | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | | `solo-sg` TRAE SOLO | `tc` 加密 | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | 路径：macOS `~/Library/Application Support//User/globalStorage/storage.json`，Windows `%APPDATA%\\User\globalStorage\storage.json`。 > **必须知道的取舍**：`tc` 格式的密钥材料**完全内嵌在密文自身**（第 6–38 字节派生），不需要 macOS Keychain，也不受它保护 —— 这意味着**本机任何能读到那个 `storage.json` 的进程都能解出你的 Trae token**。这是 Trae 自身格式的性质，不是本插件引入的。 > > 选择 `local` 会让包内存在这条解密路径。如果你关心「发布包里有没有解密凭据的代码」，请保持默认的 `oauth`。 > **`local` 随时可能失效，这是正常现象。** `storage.json` 归 Trae 客户端所有，它会自己改写这个文件 —— 退出登录、重置登录态、原地迁移都会把 `iCubeAuthInfo://icube.cloudide` 这个键删掉（本机实测发生过：该键在客户端运行期间被移除，只留下设备密钥和 usertag）。 > > 所以不要把 `local` 当成长期可靠的来源： > > - 想省事又要稳，用 `auto`（已保存的浏览器登录优先，本机凭据兜底）。 > - 键消失时插件会返回 502 并说明是哪个 edition 缺什么，**不会崩溃**；按提示在客户端重新登录，或换回 `oauth`。 > - `edition: auto` 会按 `cn → solo → sg → solo-sg` 顺序挑第一个能读的，但**不校验它的过期时间**，可能选中一个很久以前就过期的凭据（本机 `sg` 就是 2 月的）。这种时候上游会返回认证错误，看错误里的 edition 就知道换哪个了。 --- ## 配置 通过 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖： ```yaml - id: trae-cn config: credentialSource: oauth # oauth | local | auto edition: cn # local/auto 时读哪个 edition requestStyle: chat_v3 # chat_v3（实测可用）| inline_chat（实验，实测失败） appVersionCode: 20260901 # 必须是纯整数，见下方说明 ideVersion: '' # 留空 = 从本机 Trae 安装读取 displayName: Trae CN loginCommand: trae-login mountOpenAIEndpoint: true openAIPath: /trae-cn # 挂载前缀（不是 base URL）：对外接口为 /trae-cn/v1/... ``` `appVersionCode` 会作为 `x-app-version-code` / `x-ide-version-code` 发送。**它必须是纯整数**：带点的值（例如 `2.3.90452`）会被上游以 `bad request: binding: expr_path=app_version_code, cause=parameter type does not match binding data` 拒绝。 而且**网关按该值的数值大小做灰度**，值越小返回的 function 配置越少。实测阈值： | 取值 | 目录条目 | 过滤后可聊天模型 | |---|---|---| | `20260401` | 42 | 7 | | `20260701` | 46 | — | | **`>= 20260901`** | **57** | **20（完整目录）** | 默认值已取 `20260901`，无需手工配置即可看到全部模型。本机 `product.json` 的 `traeVersionCode`（`20250325`）偏旧，`detectEnv()` 只会取「不比基准旧」的值。 --- ## OpenAI 兼容接口 `mountOpenAIEndpoint: true`（默认）时，挂在宿主 web server 的 `openAIPath` 下： | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | GET | `/trae-cn/v1/models` | 模型列表 | | POST | `/trae-cn/v1/chat/completions` | 对话（流式 / 非流式，含 `reasoning_content` 与 tool calls） | | GET | `/trae-cn/health` | 健康检查 | 独立 CLI 也可以把同样的接口跑在自有端口上： ```bash node src/cli.js login # 浏览器登录 node src/cli.js models # 列出模型 node src/cli.js serve --port 8317 [--api-key ] node src/cli.js chat "你好" ``` --- ## 可用模型 模型目录是从上游实时拉取的，不在代码里硬编码。本机实测（2026-10）过滤后 **20 个**用户可选模型： | config_name | 显示名 | 思考档位 | |---|---|---| | `Doubao-Seed-Evolving` | Seed-Evolving | yes | | `Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro` | Seed-2.1-Pro-0915 | `light` / `high` | | `Doubao-Seed-2.1-Turbo` | Seed-2.1-Turbo | `light` / `high` | | `Doubao-Seed-Code` | Seed-Code | `light` / `high` | | `mimo-v2.6-flash` | MiMo-V2.6-Flash | yes | | `mimo-v2.6-pro` | MiMo-V2.6-Pro | yes | | `step-5-preview` | Step-5-Preview | `light` / `high` | | `glm-5.3-flashx` | GLM-5.3-FlashX | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.3-flash` | GLM-5.3-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.3` | GLM-5.3 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.2` | GLM-5.2 | `high` / `extra_high` | | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | DeepSeek-V4-Flash 正式版 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Official` | DeepSeek-V4-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Official` | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `kimi-k3` | Kimi-K3 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `kimi-k2.8-preview` | Kimi-K2.8-Preview | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `minimax-m3` | MiniMax-M3 | — | | `qwen3.8-flash` | Qwen3.8-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `qwen3.8-max` | Qwen3.8-Max | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `qwen-3.7-plus` | Qwen3.7-Plus | — | 目录共 57 条，其余条目（`custom_model_*` 占位、内部工具模型、`is_invisible_to_user` 的旧条目）不是可用的聊天模型，已按上游标记过滤掉 —— 放宽过滤**不会**多出可用模型，只会多出噪音。 > **两个决定目录大小的独立维度**（缺一不可，只改一个会静默停在旧目录）： > 1. `appVersionCode` 的**数值大小**（灰度阈值，见上文）。 > 2. 登录设备的 `DeviceName` —— 留成 `TraeProxy` 会被上游识别为非真客户端，只回 2 条 trial 兜底目录。现已默认取本机短主机名，可用 `TRAE_PROXY_DEVICE_NAME` 覆盖。 --- ## 与同类项目的差异 生态里已有几个同类项目，写清楚差异免得你重复踩坑： | 项目 | 形态 | 与我们不同的地方 | |---|---|---| | [`dsh-trae-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-trae-api) | DSH 插件 + 独立 HTTP 服务 | 它的目录路径写死 `%APPDATA%`，**正主在 macOS 上 100% 不可用**；且把 token **明文写进包目录下的 `.env`**；默认 API Key 硬编码；1.0.0/1.0.1 曾绑 `0.0.0.0` 且无鉴权（1.0.2 才修） | | `@casually/dsh-trae-api` | 同上（fork） | 修了 macOS 路径，**只做 HTTP 服务**，不是 DSH 原生 provider | | `@hajilongshi/dsh-trae-api` | 同上（fork） | 功能最全，但**声明的 GitHub 仓库 404**、维护者 GitHub 账号不存在，溯源无法核验 | | [Trae-Relay](https://github.com/sdn205/Trae-Relay) | Windows 单 exe（C++） | 仅 Windows；用它做协议参考（本项目的协议事实来源之一） | | [Trae-Proxy](https://github.com/arch3rPro/Trae-Proxy) | 反方向 | 是「把自己的 key 塞进 Trae」，与本项目方向相反 | 本项目的做法不同： - **DSH 原生 `LlmAdapter`**，不是外部 HTTP 服务的壳 —— 工具调用、思考档位、usage 走 DSH 原生类型，不经过有损的 OpenAI 转换 - **不自己 listen 端口**，OpenAI 兼容面挂在宿主 web server 上 - 企业版账号的刷新按账号自身的 host 走（见下），这是同类项目普遍没处理的 - 凭据落在用户目录的 `0600` 文件，不落在包目录 - 全部出网域名可枚举、有完整性校验、凭据不进日志 --- ## 实测验证状态 下面这些是**在真机上用真实账号跑过**的，不是推断： | 能力 | 结果 | |---|---| | 模型目录 `get_detail_param` | 200，57 条 config → 过滤后 20 个用户模型（`appVersionCode >= 20260901`） | | 流式对话 `llm_utils_chat` | 正文 + `reasoning_content` 增量正常 | | usage | 平铺字段正常，**prompt cache 生效**（实测 `cached_tokens: 128`） | | 原生 function calling | 完整 `tool_calls`：`get_weather {"city":"北京"}` | | `finish` 语义 | 上游在带工具调用时也回 `finish_reason: "stop"`，已按实测改成 `{kind:'tool-calls'}` | | OpenAI 兼容层 | `/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`（流式 + 非流式） | | 多模态图片输入 | 96×96 纯红 PNG 走**两条路径**都实测通过：DSH `{type:'image'}` 块 + attachments 缝，以及 OpenAI 层的 `image_url` data URL —— 模型均回答「红色」。脚本 `test/live-image.js` | | 本机凭据 `tc` 解密 | `cn`（加密）/ `sg`（明文）两种格式均解出并调通上游 | | token 刷新 | OAuth 与 local **两条来源都曾刷新成功**（走账号自己的 host、双信封解析）。**注意 refresh token 会被作废**，见下方「refresh token 会失效」 | | 过期触发刷新链路 | `test/live-refresh.js` 用隔离的凭据副本把 `expiresAt` 强制到过去，验证「过期 → 自动刷新 → 请求成功 → 新 token 落盘」；当前该凭据的 refresh token 已失效，**需要重新登录后本项才能通过**（脚本会明确诊断，不会让你误以为插件坏了） | | adapter 端到端 | `listModels` 20 个 / `resolveModel` 上下文正确 / `stream` 正文+思考+usage+工具调用 | | 跨 DSH 版本 | 在 **0.1.2-rc.1**、**0.2.0-rc.2**、**0.2.1-alpha.2** 三个宿主上分别启动并验证：provider 注册、`resolveModelInfo`、挂载接口（health / models / 对话）全部通过。后两个分别对应桌面应用打包的版本与 npm 上的最新版 | **企业版账号的两个坑**（同类项目基本没处理，会导致刷新永远失败）： 1. 刷新主机**不能写死 `api.trae.cn`**。企业版要打账号自己的 host（`account.saasBootConfig.apiHost`，或网页登录回调的 `host` 参数），否则返回 `20101 refresh token is invalid`。 2. 企业版网关用 `{code, message, Data}` 信封，不是 `{ResponseMetadata, Result}`，两者都要兼容。 ### refresh token 会失效，而且网关会把它说成「网络异常」 这是个运维事实，不是插件缺陷，但很容易误判： - 网关对一枚失效的 refresh token 回的是**自己的业务码 `30022 网络异常`**，看上去像瞬时网络故障，实际是鉴权失败，**唯一的恢复方式是重新登录**。 - refresh token **会被作废**：Trae 客户端自己那枚轮换后，你手上的副本就死了；任何一次刷新如果结果被丢弃（例如调试脚本干过一次），旧值也就没用了。 - 因此：**access token 的有效期就是「不用重新登录」的上限**（实测 `TokenExpireDuration` 是 14 天）。 插件对此的处理： - **`/trae-login` 的返回值必须符合宿主的 `CommandResult` 联合类型**。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` 会在注册边界校验它（其 `lib/index.js` 的 `normalizeResult`），不合规就抛 `command "<名字>" returned unknown result kind ""`。它只接受两种形状：`{ kind: 'success', text?: string }` 与 `{ kind: 'error', text: string }`（**字段名是 `text`**，错误文本且必须非空）。这条以前写成 `{ kind: 'text' }`，于是**每次 `/trae-login` 都会先把登录做完、再在返回的那一刻抛错**。离线套件当时只验证了命令「已注册」而没验证它的返回值，所以没抓到；现在由 `lib/support.js` 的 `commandSuccess` / `commandFailure` 统一产出，并有测试对着上面这条契约守着。 - **`prepareCall().stream()` 必须直接返回一个 AsyncIterable，不能返回「解析成 AsyncIterable 的 Promise」**。`dsh-llm@0.2.0-rc.2` 的 `adapterStream` 对 `dispatch(...)` 的返回值**同步**解引用 `[Symbol.asyncIterator]()`，拿到 Promise 就直接抛 `dispatch(...)[Symbol.asyncIterator] is not a function` —— 于是**每一次 Trae 模型调用都是立刻失败**。这条以前把 `stream` 对准了 async 的 `streamWithInfo`（它 `await` 之后才返回 chunk 生成器，等于返回 Promise）。现在由 `prepareCall()` 返回 `stream: (options) => this.streamPrepared(...)`，`streamPrepared` 是一个 async generator，`yield* await this.streamWithInfo(...)` 把「先用 Promise 完成建连、再把 chunk 流扇出」的既有时序原样保留；`test/smoke-plugin.js` 里有对着同步契约（`typeof dispatched[Symbol.asyncIterator] === 'function'`）的回归测试守着。 - **企业版/租户主机上会在两个刷新端点之间自动降级**。需要设备签名的 `/trae/api/v3/oauth/ExchangeToken` 在 `console.enterprise.trae.cn` 这类租户主机上**根本不存在**（网关回 404 + HTML），而免签名的 `/cloudide/api/v3/trae/oauth/ExchangeToken` 存在。所以刷新会先试签名那条，**只有在端点确实缺失（404/405）时**才退到免签名那条；如果服务器是**主动拒绝**签名，则原样抛出，绝不悄悄降级到更弱的流程。 - **access token 还没真过期时，刷新失败不致命**。`needsRefresh()` 提前 30 分钟触发，所以这半小时内一次短暂刷新失败会**降级为警告 + 继续用现有凭据**，而不是把本来还能成功的请求打掉。只有 token 真的过期了才硬失败。 - 硬失败时不再原样抛出「网络异常」，而是抛 `LlmError('REFRESH_FAILED')`，消息里说明「refresh token 已失效」并给出重登命令，同时保留原始上游原因便于排查。 - **401 之后的重试是真的会刷新**。这里曾经有个隐蔽 bug：旧代码靠写入 `expiresAt: 0` 来表示「强制刷新」，但 `needsRefresh()` 把 falsy 的过期时间当成「未知，不主动刷」，于是那次「重试」其实用的是同一枚刚被拒的 token。现在改成显式的 `ensureFresh(force = true)`。 - `credentialSource: local` 读到的凭据**刷新后只留在内存**，绝不写回 OAuth 凭据文件 —— 否则两个来源会静默错位。 - 上面每一条都有离线测试锁住（见「开发」一节），`test/live-refresh.js` 则把两种失效情况区分开并明确诊断。 --- ## 出网清单 代码里出现的全部外部域名： | 域名 | 用途 | |---|---| | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | CN 版模型目录 + 聊天 | | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | 国际版模型目录 + 聊天 | | `api.trae.cn` | 令牌刷新（默认 host） | | `console.enterprise.trae.cn` 等 | 企业版账号**自己的**刷新 host（由凭据决定，不写死） | | `www.trae.cn` | 浏览器授权页（仅 `oauth` 来源，由浏览器打开） | | `127.0.0.1` | 本地回调监听（仅 `oauth` 登录期间，临时端口，用完即关） | 没有任何第三方域名，没有任何把 token 发往非 Trae 域名的代码路径。 --- ## 工作原理（协议要点） 完整逆向记录见 [`PROTOCOL.md`](./PROTOCOL.md)（400+ 行）。关键点： ``` POST https://trae-api-cn.mchost.guru/api/agent/v3/llm_utils_chat Authorization: Cloud-IDE-JWT X-Cloudide-Token / X-Ide-Token / X-Uid / x-app-id / x-app-version-code / x-ide-version ... { "messages": [{ "role":"user", "content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}] }], "function": "chat_v3", "stream": true, "config_name": "glm-5.2", "model": "glm-5.2__dev", "model_name": "glm-5.2__dev", "config_source": 1, "is_custom_model": false, "provider": "" } ``` - `messages[].content` **必须是 parts 数组**，传字符串会被拒（`cannot unmarshal string into ... content of type []*...`） - `model` / `model_name` 要用目录里 `model_detail_list[].model_name`（带 `__dev` 后缀） - `tools[].function.parameters` 上游要求 **JSON 字符串**（不是对象） - SSE 事件：`output`（`content` / `response` / `reasoning` / `reasoning_content` 都是**增量**）、`token_usage`、`done`、`error`、`[DONE]` --- ## 目录结构 ``` lib/index.js 插件入口：{ name, inject, Config, apply }，注册 provider 与 adapter lib/adapter.js LlmAdapter 子类：目录 → 模型信息，Trae 事件 → StreamChunk lib/chat-body.js 请求体构造（chat_v3 / inline_chat 两种形态） lib/messages.js DSH block 消息 / legacy OpenAI 消息 → Trae parts lib/credentials.js 凭据存储与刷新（oauth / local / auto 三档） lib/attribution.js DSH 强制的 attributionHeaders 接入 src/trae-client.js 上游客户端：目录 + SSE 解析 + 工具调用累积 src/trae-auth.js OAuth 登录、回调解析、令牌刷新（两种信封） src/trae-local-credentials.js 本机凭据读取（tc 解密 + 明文） src/openai-server.js OpenAI 兼容层 src/cli.js 独立 CLI（login / models / serve / chat） ``` ## 开发 ```bash npm run check # 语法 + YAML + 清单一致性 + Config schema + 四套 smoke 测试（全部离线，mock fetch） npm test # 只跑四套 smoke 测试 ``` smoke 测试全部用 stub fetch 拦截上游，**不需要凭据、不联网**。四套分别覆盖： - `smoke-adapter.js` — `LlmAdapter` 契约：目录映射、chunk 序列、思考档位、工具调用、usage 映射，以及**凭据刷新的三条不变量**（并发调用只刷新一次、401 只重试一次不会无限循环、失效 refresh token 报可操作的 `REFRESH_FAILED`） - `smoke-client.js` — 上游客户端与凭据：企业版刷新主机、双响应信封、回调解析、tc 解密 - `smoke-plugin.js` — **插件入口 `apply()`**：Config 是否是可被 cordis 校验的 Standard Schema、provider/adapter 是否按契约注册、挂载的 OpenAI 接口是否真的能应答，以及 **`prepareCall().stream()` 同步返回 AsyncIterable**（防 `[Symbol.asyncIterator] is not a function` 回归） - `smoke-login.js` — **`/trae-login` 命令全链路**：命令注册 → `webLogin` → 授权链接 → **合成 Trae 的真实回调** → 凭据落盘。它把 `openInApp` 换成桩（否则会真的弹出浏览器），并用 `TRAE_PROXY_CRED_DIR` 隔离凭据文件，**不会碰你真实的登录态** 另有两个**需要联网的手动脚本**（不在 `npm run check` 里）： ```bash node test/live-refresh.js # 用隔离副本强制凭据过期，验证「过期 → 自动刷新 → 请求成功 → 新 token 落盘」 node test/live-image.js # 现场生成纯红 PNG，验证两条图片路径都真的被模型看见（回答「红色」） ``` `live-refresh` 会断言刷新确实打到了账号自己的 host、没有回落到 `api.trae.cn`、新 token 已落盘，并校验**你真实的凭据文件未被触碰**（比对 SHA-256）。凭据的 refresh token 已失效时它会明确诊断而不是让你以为插件坏了。 `live-image` 自己生成图片（不依赖任何 fixture），分别走 DSH 的 `{type:'image'}` 块 + attachments 缝、以及 OpenAI 层的 `image_url` data URL —— 离线测试只能断言请求体里有 data URL，**证明不了上游真的接受、模型真的看得见**，这个脚本补的就是这一步。 > 第三套是必要的：上面两个真实崩溃（Config 不是 Standard Schema、把 `http.Server` 当请求处理器）都发生在这条路径上，而它一度是零覆盖。 ### 验证插件是否真的注册进了运行中的 DSH `apply()` 不抛错**不等于**注册成功。要拿到直接证据，用只用于验证的探针覆盖层从宿主进程内部读注册状态： ```bash # 注意 --patch 是 dsh 层选项，必须放在 --profile 之前 dsh --patch test/probe-patch.yml --profile web --no-open --port 18318 ``` 启动日志会打印（同时写入 `/tmp/trae-probe-result.json`）： ``` [trae-probe] providers=[{"id":"deepseek-official",...},{"id":"trae-cn","name":"Trae CN"}] [trae-probe] trae-cn models (7)=["Doubao-Seed-Code","glm-5.2",...] [trae-probe] resolved first={"id":"Doubao-Seed-Code","contextWindow":256000,"efforts":["light","high"]} ``` 探针文件（`test/probe-catalog.mjs`、`test/probe-patch.yml`）不在 `files[]` 里，**不会进发布包**。 ### 验证发布产物本身 `link:` 安装不会装被链接包的 `dependencies`，所以它**不能**用来验证发布形态。要验证真实产物： ```bash npm pack dsh plugin --profile web remove trae-cn-provider dsh plugin --profile web add ./trae-cn-provider-.tgz ``` 从 tarball 安装时 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 会被真正装上（走真实 schema 路径，而不是内部的兜底实现），这也是发布前应当跑一遍的检查。 ### 在另一个 DSH 版本上验证（重要） `~/.local/bin/dsh` 与桌面应用打包的 DSH **是不同版本**（本机实测分别是 `0.1.2-rc.1` 和 `0.2.0-rc.2`）。只在一个版本上验证是不够的 —— 桌面才装了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的会话校验。DSH 的 API 面在两个版本间确有差异（`dsh-llm` 0.2.0-rc.2 比 0.1.2-rc.1 多出 20+ 个导出，例如 `assembleAssistantStream`、`AssistantStreamAccumulator`、`createSystemMessage`）。 桌面把整个 DSH 打进 `app.asar`，可以直接抽出来当独立 CLI 跑（`test/asar-read.mjs` 就是个最小 asar 读取器，不依赖 `npx asar`）： ```bash RES="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources" rm -rf /tmp/dsh020 && mkdir -p /tmp/dsh020 node test/asar-read.mjs "$RES/app.asar" extract dsh /tmp/dsh020 # 归档里的 .node 原生绑定是 unpacked 条目，必须从旁边补回来，否则启动会报 # "No usable native binding found for node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64" cp -R "$RES/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/." /tmp/dsh020/ node /tmp/dsh020/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js --version # 打印 0.2.0-rc.2 node /tmp/dsh020/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js \ --patch test/probe-patch.yml --profile web --no-open --port 18320 ``` 用 `web` profile 是对的选择：`desktop` profile 被正在运行的桌面应用占着，`dsh` 会拒绝操作，而且装进去需要先退出应用。 --- ## 发布 先说一个容易误解的点：**DSH 没有官方插件市场。** 在 DSH 应用里搜不到任何 `dsh-market` 组件，`dsh plugin` 本身只是 **pnpm 的透传壳**： ``` dsh plugin --profile

# 在 $DSH_HOME/profiles/

/ 里执行 pnpm ``` 所以「上市场」的落点就是**发布到 npm**： ```bash npm run check # 先跑一遍离线检查 npm pack # 可选：先验证产物内容 npm publish --access public # 需要你自己的 npm 账号 ``` 用户侧安装（`add` 之后 `reconcile()` 会自动把包追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，**安装即激活，无需手工改配置**）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add trae-cn-provider dsh plugin --profile desktop add trae-cn-provider # 需先完全退出桌面应用 ``` 社区里存在若干「DSH 市场」类的第三方索引/UI 项目，它们与本仓库无关；本插件不依赖任何索引即可安装。 ### 两个非显然的打包决定 **1. 所有 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 都标了 `optional: true`，尽管它们在运行时是必需的。** 因为它们是**宿主进程提供的**（DSH 把插件加载进自己的进程，凭 `ctx` 拿到 `llm` / `credentials` 等服务），不该从 npm 装进插件自己的 `node_modules`。 注意这些范围本身**是能从 npm 解析的**（`>=0.1.2-rc.1` → `0.1.2-rc.1`；`npm view version` 只显示 `latest` 标签，预发布版不会被打 latest，别被它误导）。问题不在装不上，而在于**多装**：声明为 required peer 时，包管理器会把 DSH 核心的一份副本拉进用户目录 —— 实测同一个 tarball： | 声明方式 | `npm install` 结果 | |---|---| | required peer | `added 14 packages` | | optional peer | `added 4 packages` | 多出来的 10 个包是宿主已经提供的 DSH 核心，纯属冗余，还可能造成同一模块存在两份实例。生态里的 `@furongjun1999/dsh-memory` 面对同样处境，做法也是全部标 optional。 **2. `prepublishOnly` 会先跑完 `npm run check`。** 所以 `npm publish` 不可能发出没通过检查的构建（语法、YAML、清单一致性、Config schema、四套 smoke）。 ### 上架 dsh.so（社区插件市场） `dsh.so` 是社区维护的 DSH 插件市场（收录 1.7 万+ 条目，带 L1–L5 验证等级）。**先发布到 npm，再去提交** —— 因为它的检查对象**恒为已发布的 tarball**，不是仓库。 要到 粘贴仓库地址或 npm 包名，检查器会拉取、校验格式、跑安全扫描，通过后生成一份条目供审核。 它的接受标准，逐条对照本包： | 标准 | 本包 | |---|---| | DSH 兼容信号（`dsh` 字段 / cordis manifest / `dsh-plugin` 话题） | ✅ `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.compatibility`，仓库已打 `dsh-plugin` 话题 | | README 带安装说明 | ✅ 「安装」小节 | | SPDX 可识别的开源许可证 | ✅ MIT + `LICENSE` | | 插件 id 符合 `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` | ✅ `trae-cn-provider` | | 仓库含可扫描源码 | ✅ 15 个 JS 文件 | | 安全扫描无阻断级发现 | ⚠️ 见下 | **关于安全扫描的风险，先说清楚**：它针对 JS/TS 做 AST 分析，找的是硬编码密钥、**数据外传端点**、破坏性操作、挖矿特征。而 dsh.so 页面上标注的扫描技术提供商是 [`dsh-plugin-vet`](https://github.com/wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet)（即 `@jieai/dsh-plugin-vet`），**它本身是可公开获取的**，所以提交前可以先自己用同一把尺子量一遍： ```sh npx -p @jieai/dsh-plugin-vet vet-gate --package node_modules/trae-cn-provider ``` `0.1.0` 的实测结果： ``` "blocked": false "verdict": "clean" 32 findings — all severity: info R3 x26 只读 process 成员（能力触达面） R15 x2 fetch 目标由运行时构造，静态不可审计（启发式） R6/R9/R10 各 1 ``` 即**无 medium/high/critical 发现**。两个值得留意的点仍在，供人工复核时对照： - **`credentialSource: local` 会解密本机 Trae 的凭据存储**。默认值是 `oauth`（不碰任何解密），但代码路径确实在包里。详见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。 - **`test/` 里的测试语料含有形如 token 的字符串**（都是 `fake-` 前缀的假值）。社区里有先例：扫描器曾把插件的测试语料当成插件的危险行为（[deepseek-harness#2818](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2818)）。 检查器在**提交之前**就会给出报告，所以先跑检查、看结论，再决定要不要提交。 收录后兼容性只会标记为 **Declared（作者声明）**；L5「运行验证通过」需要 dsh.so 自己针对具体 DSH 版本实测。你也可以按它给的模板到官方 Discussions 发兼容性报告，帮助把条目升到 Verified。 --- 发布前检查清单： - `npm run check` 全绿 - `npm pack` 的产物里包含 `cordis.patch.yml`（否则装上也白装） - 从 tarball 安装一次并启动确认（见「开发」一节的验证方法） - 版本号已更新；`private` 不是 `true` - 包元数据（`author` / `repository` / `homepage` / `bugs`）已填写 —— 别人评估「这个包可不可信」时最先看的就是它们。 --- ## 让别的 agent 框架也用上（以 Hermes 为例） `mountOpenAIEndpoint` 挂出的 `/trae-cn/v1` 是一个**标准 OpenAI 兼容端点**，所以任何支持自定义 OpenAI 端点的框架都能直接接入，**不需要改插件、也不需要第二次登录**。 以 [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes)（本机实测）为例，在 `~/.hermes/config.yaml` 加： ```yaml providers: trae: base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:19387/trae-cn/v1" api_key: "trae-local" # 端点仅监听 127.0.0.1 且无鉴权，非空即可 default_model: "glm-5.3" ``` 再 `hermes config set model.provider trae`。实测：Hermes 把它解析为 `provider: custom` / `api_mode: chat_completions`，20 个模型全部可见，流式 / 非流式 / function calling 均可用。 两个前提： - **凭据只有一份。** 消费方（Hermes）只是 HTTP 客户端，不持有 Trae 凭据；登录与刷新全部由本插件负责。DSH 里 `/trae-login` 一次，两边同时可用。 - **该端点依赖 DSH 进程存活。** 想脱离 DSH 就改用独立进程：`node src/cli.js serve --port 8317`（同样实测 20 个模型可用），配 LaunchAgent 常驻。 > 顺带说明：**别指望直接读 Trae 客户端的登录态**（`credentialSource: local`）。新版 Trae CN 已把 `storage.json` 里的键名改为动态拼接的 `iCubeAuthInfo://icube-dc:`，且该键解出来**只有设备密钥对、没有 token** —— 登录态迁到了 `state.vscdb`，那里也不存 token。`local` 因此在新版 CN 上读不到东西，属正常现象，用默认的 `oauth`。 --- ## 本仓库当前的完成度（自查用） 工程部分全部完成并已在真机验证： | 目标项 | 状态 | |---|---| | macOS 本机凭据提取（`tc` 加密 + 明文，4 个 edition） | ✅ 实测解出并调通上游 | | Trae 上游协议适配（`llm_utils_chat` SSE） | ✅ 正文 / 思考 / 工具调用 / usage / 图片全部实测 | | OpenAI 兼容 `/v1/models` + `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ 流式 + 非流式 + 工具 + 图片实测 | | 打包成 DSH bundle 插件 | ✅ 从 tarball 安装并启动验证 | | 在本机验证可用 | ✅ 在 DSH **0.1.2-rc.1** 与 **0.2.0-rc.2** 上分别验证 provider 注册与调用 | | `prepareCall().stream()` 适配 0.2.0-rc.2 的同步解引用 | ✅ `streamPrepared` async generator + 回归测试（0.1.3） | | 完整模型目录（20 个而非 7 个） | ✅ 三处版本码统一到 `20260901` + `DeviceName` 对齐真客户端（0.1.4） | | 走通发布流程 | ✅ `0.1.0`–`0.1.3` 已发布到 npm；`dsh.so` 收录见上节 | 因此剩余步骤只有两个，且都**必须由账号持有者本人操作**： 1. `npm login` 后执行 `npm publish --access public` 2. 装进日常使用的 profile：先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，再执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add trae-cn-provider` ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。 再次提醒：使用本项目违反 Trae 使用条款，且可能导致账号被封。请自行判断。

decision.reason: Held for runtime execution policy acceptance. MIT, versioned DSH documentation, native entries and exact npm gitHead identity are present. The author's README explicitly warns that the unsupported internal-API approach violates Trae terms and risks account bans. OAuth/local credential handling and this upstream-policy claim require operator review; this is not an independent legal determination. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# clawock-dsh [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/clawock-dsh?label=NPM&style=flat-square&logo=npm&logoColor=white&labelColor=252b35&color=4b91c8)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/clawock-dsh) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/KCNyu/clawock/ci.yml?label=TESTS&style=flat-square&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white&labelColor=252b35&color=738391)](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-738391?style=flat-square&labelColor=252b35)](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/master/LICENSE) **AI argues. Code settles. The losses stay on the page.** The [clawock](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock) investment-decision workflow, as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. A skill package that makes the agent walk four steps — read the request, research and argue both sides, write the decision, then let Python validate and settle it — plus a Decision Mind tab that renders every real fill as an expandable decision trace inside the DSH web GUI. The fourth step is the one that matters: the model never touches settlement. Prices, FX, P&L and the scorecard are computed by code the agent cannot write to, so a wrong call shows up as a loss on a public page instead of as a better-sounding paragraph. - **Live proof** — a real Hong Kong + US brokerage account, run this way every trading day: - **Evidence, wins and losses both** — - **Source and issues** — ![Decision Mind tab inside the DSH web GUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KCNyu/clawock/refs/heads/master/site/assets/dsh-decision-mind.png) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add clawock-dsh ``` Installation needs one more step on rc.6 and later (skill discovery), covered in the installation section below. On a host that runs clawock's agent-dispatch, the sidebar panel is also a view and control plane for that host's task queue: see [Dispatch queue](#dispatch-queue), which is in English and Chinese. The rest of this README is in Chinese. --- DeepSeek Harness 的投资决策工作流插件:agent 走完 「读请求 → 研究 + 正反辩论 → 写决策 → Python 校验结算」四步, web GUI 多一个 Decision Mind tab 把每笔成交的决策轨迹钉在页面上。 第四步是核心:**模型永远不能给自己打分**——价格、风控、账本、战绩全部由 Python 独立结算,agent 写不到那段代码,下错单显示为一笔公开页上的亏损, 而不是一段更好听的文字。 ## 前提 agent 所在环境需要 Python ≥ 3.11,并且: ```bash python -m pip install clawock ``` ## 安装 三步,缺一不可(rc.6 及以后 DSH 只扫项目根与用户根、不扫 node_modules, 所以 skill 必须手动放一步到可发现的位置): ```bash # 1. 装插件本体 dsh plugin --profile web add clawock-dsh # 2. 把 skill 放到 DSH 可发现的位置(任选其一,不选这步 agent 不会带这个 skill) cp -r ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/clawock-dsh/skills/investment-decision ~/.dsh/skills/ # 或项目级: cp -r ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/clawock-dsh/skills/investment-decision /.agents/skills/ # 3. 重启 web profile ``` 重启后 skill 即出现在 agent 的 skill 目录。 ## 快速开始 装完直接问: ``` 你:帮我分析一下 0700.HK 能不能加点仓 ``` agent 走完四步,给你一张决策卡——bull / bear / thesis / confidence / action / run_id,判定和结算是 Python 算的,不是模型说的: ![决策卡示例:agent 跑完一轮决策后输出的回执卡(示例输出,非真实结算)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KCNyu/clawock/refs/heads/master/site/assets/decision-card-example.png) ## 你得到什么 ### 一个会辩论、不会自评的 agent - 主动收集**正反双方**证据——发布时 Python 强制至少一条 opposing 论据, 熊方必须是真反驳,不是稻草人; - 有界行动:动作、数量、触发条件写进 `decision.json`,由 Python 校验; - 情绪状态自认,non-calm 才会出现在面板里。 ### 一个只读的 Decision Mind tab 装完后 web GUI 的会话视图多一个 **Decision Mind** tab。它只做一件事: **每一笔真实成交,都是一条可以点开的决策轨迹**。 - **账本式分组**:一天一组,行内 = 日期 · 标的 · 动作 · 数量@价 · T+1 判定 · 与计划反向标记 · 盈亏焦点数字,同组对齐、竖着扫就是比同一件事; - **T+1 判定**用官方逐日收盘(`memory/bars/`),绝不读实时快照;未判出就 显式写「T+1 未判」,不假装没这回事; - ### English **What it is.** agent-dispatch runs headless Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode tasks, each in its own transient systemd unit, so a task outlives the chat, terminal or dsh session that started it. The chip is one view of a control plane with three parties: | Party | Where | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | dsh chip | this package: `src/taskqueue.ts` (host half), `src/client.ts` | reads the queue; sends every write through the ops entry. Its own commands are read-only: `systemctl list-units` / `is-active` and `journalctl -u clawock-patrol -n 12` on each queue read. It never stops or restarts a unit, never takes `flock` and never edits a task directory | | ops entry | [`ops/host/task_queue_ops.py`](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/master/ops/host/task_queue_ops.py), installed to `/root/tools/agent-dispatch/` | the only code that writes to a task on the UI's behalf, and the only place the queue order is decided. Every write appends one line to the task's `audit.log`: who (`source=ui\|cli`), what changed, and the entry's `ops_version` (the sha256 of the file). The chip compares the installed `ops_version` with the repository's copy and turns red when they differ: merged but not installed | | runner | [`ops/host/agent-dispatch/`](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/tree/master/ops/host/agent-dispatch) (`run-agent.sh`, `dispatch.sh`), installed to `/root/tools/agent-dispatch/` | runs one task: waits for its agent's lock in queue order, takes a run slot, runs attempts, sleeps through quota limits, applies appends and budget changes, writes `result.env`, sends the notification | The whole contract, including every field the chip reads, is [`docs/architecture/task-queue.md`](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/master/docs/architecture/task-queue.md). **What you can do.** The ops entry's actions (`task_queue_ops.py [--json] [--source ui|cli] `). The chip calls them through its host half; the same entry works from a shell. | Action | What it does | In the chip | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `list` | per agent: lock holder, queue in real order, quota hint, tasks it cannot order | the panel itself | | `head ` | the task that takes the agent's lock next (asked by the runner on every poll) | — | | `cancel ` | stop a task; says what was lost (`queued`: nothing, `sleeping`: session kept, `running`: the current step) and how to resume | yes | | `priority ` | reorder a waiting task within its agent's queue | yes | | `model …` / `choices ` | model and effort of the **next** attempt / what is allowed for this task, from each agent's own source | yes | | `retry ` | continue an ended (not `ok/DONE`) task's session as a new task | yes | | `append [--queue]` | add an instruction to a live task, same session | only `--queue` with a fixed wrap-up text | | `log ` / `result ` | end of `run.log`, latest final report, both redacted | `log` | | `usage ` | tokens and their API-price estimate | yes | | `brief ` | `prompt.md` and every append, read-only, capped | yes | | `deadline` / `attempts` / `resumes …` | the task's deadline, retry budget, quota-resume budget | yes | Exit codes: `0` ok · `2` usage (bad id or value) · `3` refused (task ended, or the action is not allowed for this task now) · `4` unknown or pruned task · `5` host failure (systemctl, a write) · `6` busy (another write to the same task is in flight). With `--json` every answer, failures included, is one object. `append` on a **running** task stops the current step within seconds and resumes the same session with the new instruction. Nothing is cancelled and the context is kept. `--queue` waits until the current attempt ends instead. Before the task starts, an append joins its prompt. An ended task is continued with `retry`. **Queue order and fairness.** Each agent has its own lock, so each agent has its own queue, and each agent has its own run slots (`MAX_RUNNING_` in the host's `limits.env`). A claude task never waits for a codex task. Within one queue: 1. `patrol-*` rounds always go last, whatever their priority; 2. a manual task that has waited `QUEUE_FAIR_WAIT_SEC` (default 4 h) is protected: it goes before every unprotected task, and nothing can be placed in front of it any more. A task can only be overtaken during its first hours, so priority cannot starve anyone; 3. then priority, then queue time. A task that hits a quota limit **releases its agent lock** while it sleeps, so others of that agent can run. It keeps its session lock, and at the reset it rejoins the queue with its original `QUEUED_AT`, so it does not lose its place. **Budgets.** `deadline`, `attempts` and `resumes` are written to the task's `override.env` and read by the runner at every lock poll and before every attempt. A waiting task picks them up within seconds. A running task keeps the time cap its current attempt started with: the change applies from the **next attempt**. Only runners that publish `RUNNER_API=3` accept them. Nothing is restarted. **Accounting.** `usage` reads each CLI's own session record, never a guess: claude's transcript (deduplicated by API message id, because claude repeats a message's usage on every content block), codex's rollout `token_count` events (cumulative per process), and opencode's database. The amount is the tokens at **API list prices** ([`model_prices.json`](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/master/ops/host/model_prices.json)). It is an estimate, not a bill: claude and codex run on subscriptions here. claude is priced from Anthropic's API table, codex's `gpt-*` models from OpenAI's API pricing page (standard tier; URL and date in the file). A model without a price keeps its tokens and shows no amount. **Notifications.** When a task ends, and when it starts a quota wait, the runner sends one message per channel in the task's list (`weixin`, `telegram`, both by default), each once and in parallel, through `openclaw message send`. Delivery is best-effort. A failed channel does not change the task, is not retried and raises no alarm. It shows up as `notify: send failed ()` in `run.log`, in `NOTIFIED` / `NOTIFY_FAILED` / `NOTIFY_AT` in `result.env`, and as a red receipt icon in the chip. A missing notification only means nobody was told; read `result.env` before assuming the task failed. As of 2026-09-28: Telegram delivers. Its misses on 09-26/27 were 30-second notices running past their limit, because `openclaw message send` takes 13–25 s just to start on this host. The quota-wait notice has had 60 s since clawock#2057. A cancel notice keeps 30 s, the most the unit's stop budget leaves, so a cancel can still go unannounced on a busy host. WeChat has a known token problem: its per-conversation token lapses, and every WeChat send fails until it is renewed. It failed from 09-26 until the evening of 09-27, has delivered since, and can lapse again. It is not fixed. **Honest boundaries.** - There is no sandbox. The runner runs as root in an unconfined systemd unit: claude with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, codex with `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`. That is this dedicated host's choice, not a recommendation. - The chip appears only when `~/logs/agent-dispatch` exists. A host without the dispatcher sees the provider rows and nothing else. - The runner is a host tool, **not part of this npm package**. It hard-codes `/root` paths and is installed as a separate step from a clawock checkout. Create `/root/tools/agent-dispatch/` with a `limits.env` (`MAX_RUNNING_CLAUDE`, `MAX_RUNNING_CODEX`, `MAX_RUNNING_OPENCODE`, `MAX_RUNNING_DSH`, `PATROL_MIN_AVAILABLE_KB`, `PATROL_MAX_MEMORY_FULL_AVG60`, `QUEUE_FAIR_WAIT_SEC`) and, if you want notifications, a `notify.env`. Then run `ops/host/install_task_queue_ops.sh` and `ops/host/install_agent_dispatch.sh`. There is no separate head, round list or coverage link in the panel. The row opens the patrol page in the existing detail layer — back bar, focus return, Escape, no new navigation. The page opens with a **2×2 KPI grid** (latest round, open areas, open lenses, rounds), then the live head and next-round caption, the 6px outcome strip (one segment per round, newest first, 35% chart tint, counts in words), every round the host sends (at most eight) in one well, and then the coverage tables: **open issues by area** (neutral magnitude bars, amber count badges, the none-open line behind a green check) and **rounds by lens** (the open/failed lenses first under "needs a look", then the rest by last run; a 6px status dot, a neutral runs bar against the busiest lens, and an open badge — amber when positive, quiet at zero, dashed when unknown). The two one-line caveats and the provenance footer close the page. The strip draws once when the page mounts; the page itself is immediate; `prefers-reduced-motion` shows the final strip; no number is tweened. The raw supervisor log's fold inside a task detail is the only fold left. No supervisor state, dispatch behavior or patrol files are changed. 巡检在面板里只有**一个入口**：盾牌、`巡检`、实况阶段（`等下一轮`）、右边覆盖结论（`无未决` / `N 个 area 有未决` / `未决数未知`）和 chevron，入口按钮内还有一条**4px 静态结果条**（最近 8 轮、无计数、 不是第二个点击目标；整行 54px，仍 ≥44px）。面板里不再有单独的巡检头、轮次列表或覆盖链接。点开进入现有 detail layer 的巡检页——返回条、焦点返回、Escape，不新造导航。页首是 **2×2 KPI 看板**（最近一轮、未决 area、未决 lens、轮次），然后才是实况头与下一轮说明、6px 结果条（一轮一段、从新到旧、35% chart tint、 计数用文字）、host 发来的每一轮（最多 8 轮）一条列表，然后是覆盖两张表：**未决问题 · 按 area**（中性数量条、amber 计数徽章、无未决行前绿勾）和 **轮次 · 按 lens** （有未决/上一轮失败先放「需要看一眼」，其余按上次运行；6px 状态点、相对最忙 lens 的中性记录条、未决徽章 有未决 amber、零安静灰、未知虚线）。两句短 caveat 和 provenance footer 收尾。结果条在页面挂载时画一次； 页面本身立即切换；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下显示最终条；不补间数字。任务详情里 raw supervisor log 的 折叠是唯一剩下的折叠。不写巡检文件、不改 supervisor 状态或派发行为。 ### In chat: `/dispatch-list` (OpenClaw) · 聊天里看:`/dispatch-list` The same panel, as one Markdown chat message (a title, a bold line per provider, two section headings, flat lists whose rows lead with their state; no tables, nested lists or HTML; every patrol round the host sent, and no coverage tables): this package is also an OpenClaw plugin (`openclaw.plugin.json`, entry `lib/chat.js`). Add the installed package directory to OpenClaw's `plugins.load.paths` and restart the gateway; then `/dispatch-list` in WeChat or Telegram (whose menu spells it `/dispatch_list`) answers with every provider's allowance (window bars ▓░ with their resets), each agent's live tasks, what just ended with its receipts and cost, patrol and the ops foot

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# reading-workbench 阅读工作台插件 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）变成阅读工作台：书架、分页阅读器、划线批注，并让 Agent 能直接读到你在读的正文。 ## 功能 - **书架**：封面网格；支持 Markdown / TXT / HTML / EPUB / MOBI / PDF，另可把网页书源抓取成本地章节书 - **分页阅读器**：单页 / 双页，滚轮与键盘翻页，进度按「页码 + 百分比」双锚点保存 - **划线批注**：文本偏移锚点，页面重排后仍能恢复；支持与对话联动 - **阅读设置**：字号、行距、页宽、明暗主题；TXT 可切换「自动合并折行 / 保留原样」 - **Agent 工具**：`reading_books`（书目）、`reading_highlights`（划线）、`reading_excerpt`（正文节选） ## 安装 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-reading-workbench ``` 尚未发布到 npm 时，也可以直接用源码目录安装：在 profile 的 `package.json` 里以 `link:` 指向本目录， 并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。Host 半代码改动需**重启 DSH** 才生效（Node ESM 模块缓存， disable/enable 不重载）。 ## 截图 > 待补。市场卡片优先展示作者策展的截图，且只接受 GitHub 图床地址。 ## 开发状态 > 说明：下文出现的 `docs/...` 路径属于开发工作区（`dsh-plugin/docs`），**不在本仓库内**， > 仅作为设计依据与实测记录的引用。 > 状态：**三期完成并已通过真实例验收（2026-10-19）；本轮新增滚轮翻页 + TXT 段落重排**。 > v1 的多格式支持（EPUB / MOBI / PDF）已在真实实例通过验收。 > > TXT 重排（2026-10-19 本轮）：TXT 正文从「一个大 `pre` 原样保留源文件换行」改为 > **按段边界判据合并折行 + 每段一个 `p` + 首行缩进 2em + 段间距**，并提供 > 「换行：自动合并 / 保留原样」设置项。判据、偏移契约与全库实测依据见 > `docs/txt-reflow-design.md`； > 独立对抗验收报告见 `docs/diag-txt-linebreak/2026-10-19-reflow-verification.md`。 > > 全部自测套件全绿（21 套既有 + 本轮新增 `txt-layout-selftest` **193 项**、 > 独立验收 `txt-reflow-check` **1817 项**、真实浏览器几何 `txt-reflow-browser-check` **18 项**）；tsc 0 错误。 > **真实实例验收**：三格式 + 封面 + 设置 + 划线 PATCH + 进度锚点全部通过（`fiberPhase: active`）。 > 本文档是该插件的唯一权威设计来源，随开发持续更新。 > 遵循工作区根目录 `agents.md` 规范；运行时契约以当天 inspect 为准，基准探查见 `docs/dsh-runtime-notes.md`（构建实测经验在第 10、11 节）。 ## Host 半运行在 vm 沙箱里（2026-10-19 两次真实事故，必读） 插件 install 成功、产物正确、静态 import 全部可解析，但 DSH 里 `fiberPhase` 一直 `failed`、 全部 REST 路由 401/404。**两轮排查抓到两个独立根因**。 ### 事故一：沙箱里没有 `process` / `Buffer` `apply` 第一行的 `process.env.DSH_HOME` 直接抛 `ReferenceError: process is not defined`， cordis 记 `_error`、state 转 `FAILED`，**连 14 条路由一起消失**；`writeJson` 里的 `Buffer.byteLength` 是第二颗地雷（首次响应才炸）。 修复：数据目录改由 `config.dshHome` / `ctx.get('sandbox'|'storage'|'workspace')` 提供并回落 `~/.dsh`； 编解码统一 `TextEncoder` / `TextDecoder`；`readBody` 返回 `Uint8Array`。 ### 事故二：`ctx.tools` 没写进 `inject` 修完事故一仍然 failed。这次用**宿主自己的启动参数起副本、把 stderr 落盘**，才看到真话： ```text reading-workbench: Error: cannot get property "tools" without inject at …/lib/index.mjs:1612:12 ``` cordis 里读**未 inject 的服务**是**抛异常**而不是返回 `undefined`——于是 `if (ctx.tools === undefined)` 这种"判空跳过"自己就会炸，且炸在 `ctx.effect` 回调里 会被记成整条 fiber FAILED，`try/catch` 兜不住。 修复：`inject = ['webServer', 'tools']`；服务读取移到 effect 之外并显式 try/catch， 取不到就只少三个工具，书架与阅读照常。 **排查心法**：`list_plugins` 只给一个 `fiberPhase: "failed"` 字符串，没有异常文本。 最快的路径永远是**抓宿主 stderr**，别靠本地猜。 防线：`scripts/sandbox-contract-check.mjs`（已接进 `pnpm build` / `pnpm check`）—— 在**不带 process 的 vm 沙箱** + 真实 cordis + **白名单 ctx Proxy** 里跑 apply，断言 ACTIVE， 并带多条断言/反证（还原 `process.env` 必 FAILED；漏声明 `tools` 时只少工具、不拖垮宿主）。 完整事故复盘见 `docs/m2-agent-tools-notes.md` 第三、四节。 ## 文本编码契约（2026-10-19 事故三，必读） **症状**：导入一本 GBK 老 txt（`蓝天航空公司的空姐.txt`，1.05 MB）后满屏菱形问号 （`�`），夹杂零星拉丁/西里尔/希腊字母；同一本书打开还特别慢。 **根因**（两层，缺一不可）： 1. **编码**：`File.text()` / `readFile(path,'utf8')` 都是「UTF-8 宽松解码」， GBK 字节被逐段解成 U+FFFD（`�`）；恰好构成合法 UTF-8 序列的字节对被解成别的文字 （`D5 B9` → 希伯来文等）。更糟的是导入时把**已损坏的字符串写回书库副本** （`library/.txt`），损坏被永久固化 —— 该副本 2.44 MB，含 681,143 个替换符。 2. **性能**：txt 没有章节结构，旧实现把整本书当成一个排版单元塞进 CSS 多栏容器 （`column-fill: auto` + 固定高度），55 万字要一次排出 400~600 列。 **现在立的规矩（改代码时必须守住）**： 1. **导入只收原始字节**：客户端用 `file.arrayBuffer()` 走二进制通道 （`/books/upload-binary`，`format=txt|md` 也走它），Host 侧统一入口 `store.importTextBookFromBytes(paths, meta, bytes)`。 **任何地方都不得先解码再上传/落盘。** 2. **解码严格、二选一、失败即报错**：`shared/text-encoding.ts` 的 `decodeTextBytes` 按 `BOM → UTF-8(fatal) → GB18030(fatal) → 抛 TextDecodeError` 判定， **绝不接受宽松解码产出的替换符**。GB18030 是 GBK/GB2312 的超集，覆盖中文老书。 3. **两道损坏闸门**： - 落库前 `inspectReplacementDamage`（>1% 且 ≥20 个）拒绝导入（`importBookFromContent`）； - 打开时同一判据命中就报错「本书导入时被错误解码损坏，请重新导入」 （`store.readBookContent`）—— 已损坏的副本无法修复，只能重导， 绝不把乱码当正常内容渲染给用户。 4. **副本恒为规范 UTF-8**：`library/.` 只有这一种编码，读取端不再猜。 **txt 虚拟单元（性能）**：`client/txt-units.ts` 的 `splitTextUnits` 把正文切成若干单元 （章节标记行优先，否则约 2 万字一处；整本无换行的长文按字符强制切）， 阅读器一次只渲染一个单元。偏移契约：`unit.text === text.slice(unit.start, unit.end)`， 且 `start` 是**全书字符偏移** —— 因此划线锚点仍是全书偏移，旧划线无需迁移， 渲染时用 `toUnitRange` 换算成单元内偏移。实测同一本书：556,817 字 → 27 个单元， 最大单元 36,364 字，单次排版量降到整本的 6.5%。 配套自测：`scripts/encoding-selftest.mjs`（编码表驱动 + 损坏判据 + 切分偏移契约）、 `scripts/host-upload-selftest.mjs` 的 10~12 号用例（GBK 二进制导入 / 非法编码拒绝 / 旧 JSON 通道拦替换符）。已损坏的历史数据用 `docs/diag-blue-sky-encoding/repair-damaged-import.mjs` 重导（自动备份副本与 data.json）。 ## Agent 工具（M2，2026-10-16） 三个只读工具把书库接进 DSH 会话（在对话里问「我有哪些书」「那本小说讲了什么」时，Agent 可直接查）： | 工具 | 参数 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `reading_books` | — | 书架列表（书名/作者/格式/进度）；`render` 输出人读友好的书单 | | `reading_highlights` | `bookId?` `limit?` | 划线批注（含笔记），按时间倒序；可跨书查 | | `reading_excerpt` | `bookId` `offset?` `length?` | 正文节选（单次上限 4000 字），章节书剥成纯文本、图片占位为 `[图片]` | ### 关键实现决策：不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 首版直接 `import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'`，结果**在测试阶段就炸了**： dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 的 ESM 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的 `CallId` 导出， 而本机运行时的 dsh-llm 0.2.0-rc.2 已把它改名 `ToolCallId` —— 版本族错位，`import` 阶段即抛 `SyntaxError: does not provide an export named 'CallId'`，**会炸掉整个宿主启动**。 复盘 `defineTool` 的源码后确认它只是「schema 编译 + 参数校验包装」的纯数据变换， 因此按同形态自实现（含参数校验、`ToolArgsError`、`parametersToJsonSchema`）， 不引入任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时依赖，工具对象与官方形态逐字段对齐。 `tools-selftest` 验证：注册形态、schema 编译、execute 输出、render 文本、过滤/倒序/limit、HTML 剥离、越界与报错，共 26 项。 设计取舍：工具**只读**（不提供写入/删除）——划线由人类在 GUI 里做，Agent 只消费。 ## 划线批注（M3，2026-10-16） 正文选中文字 → 浮动「划线」按钮 → 入库并即时高亮；工具栏「划线 N」打开笔记抽屉。 ### 定位模型：文本偏移锚点（重排后仍可恢复） 页码/屏号会随字号与视口变化，**文本不会**，因此划线锚点记录「章节 + 单元内字符偏移 + 长度」： ```text 章节书：mark:ch=2:off=17:len=9 （ch 为章节序；段间 : 分隔、段内 key=value） 文本类：mark:off=120:len=30 ``` - 恢复时按偏移在单元文本里重建 `` 包裹；找不到（内容改版）静默跳过，不报错——`text` 始终随划线存库，笔记栏永远能展示原文。 - **分隔符刻意设计**：段间 `:`、段内 `=`。首版把 key/value 也用 `:` 连接（`mark:ch:5:off:17`），split 后 key 与 value 分家、全部字段解析失败——`mark-selftest` 的往返断言抓住了它。 - 选区超长（>600 字符）拒绝并提示，防止把整章划成一条。 - 笔记随划线存库，`PATCH /highlight?id=` 更新（正文不可改，只允许 note）；空串即清除。 ### 交互细节 - 高亮恢复用「逐节点切分 + Range 包裹」而非 `surroundContents` 一把梭——划线常跨段落，后者直接抛错；包不住的片段退化为 extract/insert，再不行就跳过该片段（不破坏 DOM）。 - 点正文里的高亮 → 打开笔记抽屉；抽屉里「定位」按偏移比例换算目标屏并平滑滚动到该句。 - PDF 暂不支持划线（pdf.js 文字层是另一套坐标体系，待做）。 ## UI v2：界面结构与交互（2026-10-16 重构） 用户反馈「看书界面太难看」，因此把 UI 从「左窄书架 + 右正文」改成**先书架、后沉浸阅读**两态： ``` ┌─ 书架态 ────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 书架 12 本 [搜索] [排序] [导入书籍] │ │ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ ┌────┐ │ │ │封面│ │封面│ │封面│ │封面│ │封面│ ← 2:3 书封网格 │ │ └────┘ └────┘ └────┘ └────┘ └────┘ 底部进度条 │ │ 书名 书名 书名 书名 书名 │ ├─ 阅读态（点书进入，占满整屏）──────────────────────┤ │ ‹返回 书名 [章节目录▾] [自适应|单页|双页] A－ A＋ │ │ ┌──── 分页正文（CSS 多栏，一屏 1~2 栏）────┐ │ │ │ 左右点击热区翻页 / 方向键 / 空格 / PgUp/PgDn │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ ‹ 章节 3/12 · 5/9 页 ▓▓▓▓░░░░ 62% › │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 分页是怎么实现的 不切分 DOM、不测量每个段落，而是用 **CSS 多栏排版**： 1. 正文容器固定高度 + `column-fill: auto`，整篇内容被排成 N 个等宽列并横向溢出； 2. 外层视口 `overflow: hidden` 只露出**一屏**（单页 = 1 列宽，双页 = 2 列宽 + 间距）； 3. 翻页 = 对内层施加 `translateX(-屏号 × 步长)`。 > ⚠️ **两个几何量必须分清**（曾混用，导致「按键盘下一页切换不准确」）： > - **flow 宽度** = `screenWidthOf` = 可见列宽之和 + 列之间那 `cols-1` 个间距（一屏能显示的内容宽）； > - **翻页步长** = `stepOf` = 可见列数 × (列宽 + 间距)（跨到下一屏的实际距离）。 > > 二者相差恰好一个 `COLUMN_GAP`：一屏右边界止于末列右缘，下一屏首列要从「末列右缘 + 间距」处起排。 > 用 `screenWidth` 当步长会每翻一屏累积偏移 48px —— 左侧露出上一列的尾巴、右侧正文被切。 好处是「页码」是**真实排版结果**：改字号、拉窗口都会自动重排并重算页数； `ResizeObserver` + 内容区 `load` 监听负责补测（图片加载会改变排版宽度）。 `nextPage` 换回闭包计数后，该测试立刻失败并给出「1 → 2（期望 6）」， 与用户描述的症状一致，证明测试有效而非空转。 ### 本轮自查发现并修掉的真 bug | # | 问题 | 现象 | 修法 | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | **点击热区挂在被平移的内层元素上** | 翻到第 2 屏后 `getBoundingClientRect().left` 变成负值，点左侧三分之一也算「右侧」→ **只能往后翻、不能往前翻** | 点击监听到**未平移**的外层视口，热区按内容盒（扣掉左右内边距）计算 | | 2 | **双页模式下热区仍是 30% / 40% 空白带** | 双页时点中间 40% 毫无反应，与「点左边回看、点右边继续」的直觉不符 | 双页按中线二分 | | 3 | **EPUB 封面回落策略过宽**：「取 manifest `pct/100*pageCount`，`paginate.ts` 的 `restoreView` 用 `pct/100*(count-1)` —— 同一百分比换算出不同页 | 统一刻度，并加**一致性交叉断言**（count 2..12 × pct 5 档全比对）钉住 | 第 1、2 条属于「纯函数测试测不出、只有真渲染/真浏览器才能发现」的类别； 第 5、6 条更进一步：**需要真实交互序列 + 独立判据**才能发现。 因此验证分层补成四层：真渲染组件（`ui-render-check`）、真浏览器几何（`pagination-browser-check`、 `paging-align-check`、`panel-height-check`）、真组件 + 真事件（`reader-keyboard-check`）。 ## 9. 本轮改动记录（TXT 段落重排，2026-10-19） evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-wsl

A WSL compute backend for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) on Windows.

Keep DSH on Windows for editing, literature and writing; run computation inside WSL. This plugin is the seam between the two: six host-side tools that start Python in a conda environment, run bash, and manage long jobs — without the quoting, environment and encoding problems that come from driving `wsl.exe` by hand.

```
Windows:  DSH, your editor, your files            →  wsl_py / wsl_sh / wsl_job
WSL:      conda env, PySCF, the heavy lifting      ←  6 tools, no profile edits
```

Nothing is specific to one machine: the distribution, Linux home, conda installation and default environment are **detected on first use** and can each be overridden in the profile config. `wsl_doctor` prints what was found and where every value came from.

---

## Status: what is verified, and what is not

Read this before trusting a long run.

### Test matrix

Everything below is executed by the repository's own suites (`node selftest.mjs` and `node tests/*.mjs`), which exit non-zero on any failed check.

| Suite | Checks | Runs | Covers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selftest.mjs` | 73 | anywhere, no WSL | DSH 0.2 tool contract, `wsl -l -v` parsing (localized headers, names with spaces), path translation, interpreter resolution, launcher-noise filter |
| `tests/drivetest.mjs` | 56 | Windows + WSL | detection, all six tools, `env="none"`, no-conda mode, wrong-distribution error |
| `tests/jobtest.mjs` | 28 | Windows + WSL | submit, poll, incremental logs, collect, kill, provenance fields |
| `tests/edgecases.mjs` | 38 | Windows + WSL | hostile workdirs, failed-job records, timeout, 200 KB output, heredoc delimiters inside user code, injection-shaped inputs, no-conda mode end to end |

Measured on the author's machine (Windows 11, WSL2 Ubuntu 20.04, 32 cores, six conda environments): `wsl_py` ≈ 1 s warm, `wsl_sh` ≈ 150 ms, `wsl_env list` ≈ 2 s for six environments, detection ≈ 300 ms once per process.

### Known limitations and defects

These are current, real limits — not a roadmap.

1. **One distribution per instance.** Multi-distro users pick one in config. There is no per-call `distro` argument; `wsl_doctor` lists all installed distributions so at least the choice is informed.
2. **The no-conda path is tested by simulation, not on a conda-less machine.** `condaRoot: none` exercises the same code path, but the maintainer has no machine that genuinely lacks conda, so a first run on one is less proven than the rest.
3. **conda discovery is a guess list plus a login-shell probe.** An installation in an unusual place (a `micromamba` root, a custom prefix, conda owned by another user) needs an explicit `condaRoot`. Detection reports the candidates it tried.
4. **bash is required.** Scripts are piped to `bash -s`; a bash-less distribution (Alpine, some container-based images) is rejected with a clear message rather than silently degraded.
5. **`wsl -l -v` parsing is locale-tolerant but only tested against a hand-written Chinese header**, not a genuinely localized Windows installation.
6. **WSL1 distributions are untested.** Nothing in the code assumes WSL2, but no WSL1 environment was available.
7. **A `timeoutMs` expiry kills the `wsl.exe` launcher, not necessarily the Linux process it started.** For anything that must be stoppable, use `wsl_job` and `kill`.
8. **`collect` needs the `\\wsl$\<distro>` share.** When it is unavailable the tool says so and points at `wsl_sh`; it does not fall back automatically.
9. **`workdir` must already exist.** The tools deliberately do not create one: a missing directory is far more often a typo than an intention.
10. **Jobs are not queued or throttled.** Every `wsl_job run` launches immediately; there is no concurrency limit and no scheduler.
11. **`budgetSeconds` is advisory.** Over-budget jobs are flagged in `status`, never killed.
12. **No client half.** There is no UI; the tools are the interface, and there is no browser refresh to trigger.
13. **DSH tool contract ≥ 0.2 only.** Builds that still accept `{ content, isError }` are not supported; the six definitions would fail to register.
14. **Non-Windows hosts are inert.** The plugin logs one error and registers nothing.
15. **The environment inventory is not refreshed on its own.** `wsl_env list` re-reads when called, but the internal env-name cache only clears on reload.

Defects found and fixed in 0.3.0 (all four also affected 0.2.0) are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): a failed job corrupting its own status record, `wsl_env install` swallowing pip failures, `wsl_job run` accepting both `code` and `script`, and fixed heredoc delimiters that user code could close early.

---

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 with WSL2 and at least one distribution (`wsl.exe` on `PATH`).
- A DSH build with the 0.2 tool contract — definitions declare `output: { schema, render }`.
- `bash` inside the distribution (see limitation 4).
- conda is optional. With conda you get named environments and `wsl_env`; without it the tools fall back to the distribution's `python3`.
- Node ≥ 22 only for the tests; DSH brings its own runtime.

## Why this exists

Calling WSL from a Windows agent is easy to get wrong, and every failure mode looks like something else:

| Symptom | Real cause |
|---|---|
| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyscf'` | A PATH prepend does not survive: `~/.bashrc` runs conda's init and puts `anaconda3/bin` back in front, so bare `python` is base, not your env |
| Commands mangled, `$var` expanded early, regexes broken | Three levels of quoting (PowerShell → `wsl.exe` → bash); escaping is not reliably solvable |
| `node`/`conda` not found | `BASH_ENV` is only read by non-interactive bash *and* must be inherited, so `wsl bash -c` never loads your shell profile |
| Chinese text becomes `??` or mojibake | WSL CLI output is UTF-16LE to Windows; a naive UTF-8 decode misreads it |
| A job "succeeds" but produced nothing | A heredoc consumed stdin, so the line that launched the background process never ran |

Each of those is handled deliberately here, and each is documented at the point in the source where it matters.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `wsl_py` | Run Python in a named conda environment (`env="none"` for the system `python3`). Parameters: `code`, `env`, `workdir`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `wsl_sh` | Run a bash snippet. Parameters: `script`, `env`, `workdir`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `wsl_path` | Translate `C:\x` ↔ `/mnt/c/x`, `\\wsl$\Distro\x` ↔ `/x`, and `~` → the detected home; `check=true` stats the target inside WSL. |
| `wsl_env` | `list` environments (Python version, distribution count, size); `packages` for one; `diff` two of them; `install` into one. Needs conda. |
| `wsl_job` | `run` a detached job; `status`; `logs` (incremental via `offset`); `kill`; `collect` the run record back to Windows. |
| `wsl_doctor` | Detection report and preflight: distribution, home, conda, interpreter, resources, package versions, encoding, GPU, workdir. |

Every tool returns text; a script exiting non-zero makes the tool call fail (`isError`) while keeping stdout and stderr.

### `wsl_job` in detail

- `run` starts a detached process (`nohup … &`, `disown`) that survives a DSH restart; `status` re-attaches to it by reading its directory.
- It records provenance: host, kernel, CPU count, interpreter path, Python/numpy/scipy/pyscf versions, the payload's sha256, git commit and dirty state, and a `reproduce` line.
- It reports its own exit code and peak memory (`/usr/bin/time -f %M`).
- Files a job creates land in its `workdir` — they belong to your project. `collect` copies only the run's own record.
- `logs` reads by byte offset and returns `NEXT_OFFSET`, so repeated calls do not resend output.

## Installation

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle: `package.json` with a `dsh.bundle.patch` entry, a bundle patch, and one ESM file exporting `name` and `apply`. No dependencies, no client half.

```sh
cd <your DSH profile>/node_modules
git clone https://github.com/KonataRings/dsh-wsl.git
```

Then declare it in the profile's `package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-wsl": "file:node_modules/dsh-wsl"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // …existing bundles…
        "dsh-wsl"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Restart DSH and ask the model to run `wsl_doctor` — the first call pays for detection and prints what it found.

A `file:` dependency is not resolved by the plugin CLI's own install path, which is why the two edits above are manual. A published package (or a git dependency) installs the normal way.

## Configuration

Everything is optional. Override any field in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-wsl
  name: dsh-wsl
  config:
    distro: Ubuntu-22.04        # pin a distribution when several are installed
    # home: /home/you           # only if $HOME is not what you want
    # condaRoot: /opt/conda     # only if detection guesses wrong
    # defaultEnv: base          # only if you do not want the default
    budgetSeconds: 14400
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `distro` | detected | Distribution passed to `wsl -d`. Unset = whichever one `wsl.exe` treats as default. |
| `home` | detected | Linux home; the default working directory. Unset = `$HOME`. |
| `condaRoot` | detected | conda installation. Unset = probe `~/anaconda3`, `~/miniconda3`, `~/miniforge3`, `~/mambaforge`, `~/miniconda`, `~/anaconda`, `/opt/conda`, `/opt/anaconda3`, `/usr/local/anaconda3`, then `bash -lc 'conda info --base'`. Set to `none` to force the `python3` fallback. |
| `defaultEnv` | `base` / `none` | Environment used when a call names none. `base` when conda exists, `none` otherwise. |
| `jobsRoot` | `<home>/.dsh-wsl/jobs` | Where job directories live. |
| `windowsJobsRoot` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\wsl-jobs` | Windows-side mirror used when `collect` has no `output`. |
| `budgetSeconds` | `14400` (4h) | Over-budget jobs are flagged in `status`, never killed. |
| `defaultTailBytes` | `65536` | Default log window for `wsl_job logs`. |
| `detectTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Upper bound on the one-time detection round trip. |

`wsl_doctor` labels each resolved value with its source: `config`, `detected`, `detected (default)`, `derived`, or `default`.

## Job layout

```
<jobsRoot>/<id>/
  payload.sh        the code or script, plus the environment preamble
  run.sh            self-contained runner; re-runnable by hand
  write-meta.py     the provenance writer (kept so job.json can be rebuilt)
  started_at  ended_at  exit_code  done  maxrss_kb
  stdout.log  stderr.log
  job.json          host, kernel, cpus, python/pkg versions, payload sha256,
                    git commit and dirty state, and a reproduce line
```

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | What to do |
|---|---|
| No `wsl_*` tools in the session | The definitions never registered. Check the DSH build accepts `output: { schema, render }`; a rejected definition logs `dsh-wsl: could not register …`. |
| `no conda installation was found` | Set `condaRoot`, or use `env: "none"` deliberately. `wsl_doctor` lists the candidates it probed. |
| `bash was not found in "<distro>"` | The distribution is bash-less. Install bash or pick another distribution. |
| `distribution "X" is not installed` | The config pins a name that does not exist; the error lists what does. |
| `collect` fails on `\\wsl$\…` | Copy from inside WSL instead: `wsl_sh: cp -r <linuxDir> <target>`. |
| `DISTS` shows `-` for an environment | That environment is Python 2 and has no `importlib.metadata`. |
| `wsl_py` cannot import a package | Check with `wsl_doctor` which interpreter was selected; a bare `python` on PATH is not the same thing. |
| A job's `status` looks wrong | Read `job.json` and the job's own `stdout.log`/`stderr.log`; the record is plain files. |

## Testing

```sh
node selftest.mjs           # offline: contract, distro-list parsing, path translation, noise filter
node tests/drivetest.mjs    # live: detection + every tool
node tests/jobtest.mjs      # live: submit, poll, tail, collect, kill
node tests/edgecases.mjs    # live: hostile paths, failed jobs, timeouts, injection shapes
```

`selftest.mjs` needs no WSL: it registers the tools through a mock registry that enforces the same rules as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, checks the pure functions, and asserts that no default carries a machine-specific path.

The live suites detect the environment the same way the plugin does and accept `DSH_WSL_TEST_DISTRO`, `DSH_WSL_TEST_HOME`, `DSH_WSL_TEST_CONDA` and `DSH_WSL_TEST_ENV` as overrides. All exit non-zero on any failed check.

## License

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Single-kernel architecture | **occt.ts as the primary modeling kernel** (true B-splines, native shell/draft, centroid); opencascade.js stays only as the fallback backend; the old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane); sections may differ in shape and point count; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling primarily runs on the **occt.ts kernel** (opencascade.js as the fallback backend) (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (opencascade.js WASM)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (opencascade.js, full OCCT) are separate, both lazily started; the `_N`
  suffix convention of embind overloaded constructors is wrapped in
  `src/modeling/occt-adapter.cjs` (all verified at runtime)
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. New APIs over opencascade.js: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Single-kernel architecture**: the primary modeling kernel is
  **occt.ts** — primitives, curve-segment profiles (TRUE B-spline
  interpolation), loft/sweep/revolve, booleans, fillet/chamfer, shell/draft,
  mirror (composed as scale(-1) + a π rotation) and centroid all live in one
  session; engineering-drawing HLR takes the shape directly (zero STEP hops);
  editing after shelling is seamless (the old hosted-body seam is deleted).
  opencascade.js remains as the FALLBACK backend (auto-selected when occt.ts
  cannot load). Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document** (occt.ts
  `writeStepDocument`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh; the fallback backend also fuses). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/m0-kernel-check.cjs        # OCCT kernel API smoke test
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

# BUAAer 智能日程

专为北航学生设计的日程管理工具：课程表同步、任务截止、日历条目、到期提醒。当前主开发线是 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Cordis 插件**形态——作为宿主内的 bundle 运行，无独立后端/端口/鉴权。

> **状态（2026-10-20）**：插件已拆成「日程核心 + 来源适配器」：`@lidozs55/dsh-schedule`
> 负责通用日程数据/UI/提醒/工具，`@buaaer/dsh-schedule-buaa` 通过注入 `buaaerSchedule`
> 提供北航 SSO 同步与旧库导入。桌宠桥 `@lidozs55/dsh-schedule-bridge` 保持 v1
> （提醒气泡 + 状态信号，`docs/dsh-plugin/09`）。旧 Electron 实现暂时保留，待插件完全稳定后删除。

## 仓库结构

```
dsh-plugin/dsh-schedule/           # 日程核心 @lidozs55/dsh-schedule（Host + Client）
dsh-plugin/buaaer-schedule-buaa/   # 北航来源适配器 @buaaer/dsh-schedule-buaa（依赖核心）
dsh-plugin/dsh-schedule-bridge/    # 桌宠桥 @lidozs55/dsh-schedule-bridge（host-only，docs 09）
docs/dsh-plugin/                   # 开发文档（架构基线 / DSH 平台参考 / 任务记录）
scripts/export-legacy-db.mjs       # 旧 SQLite 库 → JSON 导出（一次性迁移用）
electron/ backend/ frontend/ 与根级旧脚本  # 旧 Electron 实现（意图参照，docs/dsh-plugin/00 §7，验收后删除）
```

## 安装与使用

1. 安装进 DSH 宿主：依次安装 `dsh-plugin/dsh-schedule`、`dsh-plugin/buaaer-schedule-buaa`
   （可选桌宠桥 `dsh-plugin/dsh-schedule-bridge`）。链接安装后改源码重启宿主即生效。
2. 侧边栏出现「日程」入口；设置里有两节：「日程设置」（学期起点、数据导入导出）与
   「北航教务导入」（学号、教务同步、旧库导入）。其他学校/来源可按
   `docs/dsh-plugin/11-source-plugins.md` 的契约新增适配器。
3. 旧数据迁移：`node scripts/export-legacy-db.mjs` 导出 JSON → 会话内 `/buaaer-import <路径>`
   或在「北航教务导入」设置卡图形导入。

## 文档

- **架构与决策基线**：`docs/dsh-plugin/00-architecture.md`
- **新增日程来源**：`docs/dsh-plugin/11-source-plugins.md`
- DSH 插件开发参考（平台契约、服务/UI/数据/工具速查）：同目录 `01`–`06`、`08`
- 桌宠桥设计（已落地 v1）：`docs/dsh-plugin/09-vivarium-bridge.md`
- UI 意图对齐返工记录（已完成）：`docs/dsh-plugin/10-ui-parity-rework.md`

## 核心行为约定

- 课程按「第 1-16 周」式周期规则存储，任意教学周**现算**出现（不物化行）。
- 显示日 = 04:00 → 次日 04:00（凌晨 0–4 点属于前一格日；客户端几何在 `client.gridmath.js`，宿主锚点在 `host/semester.js`，各只此一份）。
- 修改任务/条目的唯一实现是 Host 领域服务；UI 与 Agent 工具（`buaaer_*`）调同一方法。
- 插件内零 LLM 调用：自然语言建日程 = 在会话内让 Agent 调工具。
- 学号等来源状态由来源插件持久化在核心 domain 的 `sourceState`；教务密码只作当次调用入参，绝不落盘。
- 提醒由 `ctx.schedule` durable 承担，投递回绑定会话；桌宠气泡是增强表面（桥插件），关掉桥提醒不受影响。
